name: screenshare-p2p
description: Ultra low latency 1080p P2P screen sharing with audio for couples

scripts.build-windows: npm run build-helper && npx @neutralinojs/neu build && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist\StreamGrid\bin | Out-Null; Copy-Item bin\streamgrid-audio-helper.exe -Destination dist\StreamGrid\bin\streamgrid-audio-helper.exe -Force; Copy-Item bin\streamgrid-audio-helper.exe -Destination dist\StreamGrid\streamgrid-audio-helper.exe -Force; Get-ChildItem -Path dist\StreamGrid -Include *linux*, *mac* | Remove-Item -Force; Compress-Archive -Path dist\StreamGrid -DestinationPath dist\StreamGrid-Windows.zip -Force"
